what: the provisioned per-episode tariff q_v2 of the JevAgentRL-v2 profile row (docs/PREREG_A7_STAGE2.md A7.19 (f): "its own tariff measured as A7.13 (iii)"; exploratory, descriptive), measured as the S2-4 and S2-4S tariffs (results/stage2/tariff_rl_plan.json, results/stage2/tariff_sl4b_plan.json)

configuration.profile: configs/harness/jevagent_best.yaml (Flash section with the fitted backends.jevagentrl_v2 block from v2_shadow_cal, A7.1 (f) / A7.18 (e) 4)
configuration.system1: JevAgentRL-v2 (the frozen checkpoint of results/gpu_round6_miles/final_FROZEN.txt: StartLux-Decision-4B fully fine-tuned, Hugging Face format, with its temperature file) served by training/serve_jev.py on :8084 under the name jevagentrl-v2 in the v2 serving venv (flash-linear-attention / causal-conv1d kernels; results/stage2/v2_eval_plan.json): session cache on, multi-question suffix batching on, serve_jev defaults otherwise

warmup.purpose: the server's first requests (CUDA allocation, Triton kernel compilation of the linear-attention kernels, session cache) outside the window; not counted

workload.suite: jevgym (the Stage-2 suite settings of configs/experiments/stage2_v2.yaml), development seeds
workload.task_seeds: 600-699 (the S2-4 and S2-4S tariffs' seeds: the three tariffs are measured on one workload)

window.start: the UTC time the workload command is launched (after the warm-up)
window.end: the UTC time the workload command exits
window.contents: only the workload: no other job runs on the GPU host inside the window; executor waiting and provisioned idle time inside it are included

host.instance_type: the Stage-2 host's type at measurement, read from the instance metadata and recorded with the tariff; priced by usd_per_hour_by_type (a type not listed: the stage refuses)
host.reference_note: the host type of the S2-4 and S2-4S tariffs; when the measurement host is another listed type, the same window priced at the reference type is a sensitivity row (reference_host), never the tariff
host.price_source: AWS Price List API (AmazonEC2, Linux, shared tenancy, on demand, capacitystatus Used, no pre-installed software), read 2026-10-04 (effective 2026-09-01)

formula: q_v2 = host $/h x (window end - window start) / completed development episodes (latest record without an infrastructure error); scripts/stage2_tariff.py --arm jevagent_best_v2 --served-model jevagentrl-v2 --out results/stage2/tariff_v2.json
served_model_price: jevagentrl-v2 is an exact 0 per-token entry in configs/prices/models.yaml (nothing charged twice)
sensitivity: busy-throughput tariff (union of in-flight System-1 calls x host $/h / episodes), Jev's API price ($0.042 / M System-1 input tokens), $0, the reference-host price when the host is not the reference type, and the realised evaluation-host bill beside it (A7.13 (iii))
